title: The Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018 (c. 13). Regulations 3 to 29 amend the Russia (Sanctions) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/855) (“the 2019 Regulations”). Regulation 30 amends the Trade, Aircraft and Shipping Sanctions (Civil Enforcement) Regulations 2024 (S.I. 2024/948) (“the TASSCE Regulations”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Scarborough Armed Forces Day) Regulations 2026
The Customs (Tariff and Miscellaneous Amendments) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2 amends the definition of “the authorised use document” in regulation 32(2) of the Customs (Special Procedures and Outward Processing) (EU Exit) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/1249) to refer to a new version of that document. The new version of this document introduces the Authorised Use procedure for frozen bovine, subject to a tariff quota.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Lasham Sailplane Grand Prix) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (State Fayre, Chelmsford) Regulations 2026
The Income Tax (Exemption of Kinship Allowance Payments in Kinship Zones) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends section 744 of the Income Tax (Trading and Other Income) Act 2005 to exempt from income tax, sums paid under a pilot scheme known as Kinship Zones under which the Department for Education will provide funding to certain local authorities in England and Wales to provide an allowance for kinship carers.

title: The A46 Coventry Junctions (Walsgrave) Development Consent Order 2026
summary: This Order authorises National Highways to undertake works to alter the Walsgrave junction of the A46 near Coventry and carry out all associated works.

title: The National Health Service (Charges to Overseas Visitors) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the National Health Service (Charges to Overseas Visitors) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/238) (“the 2015 Regulations”) which provide for the making and recovery of charges for relevant services provided under the National Health Service Act 2006 (c. 41) to overseas visitors, i.e. persons not ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom.

title: The Health Protection (Notification) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Health Protection (Notification) Regulations 2010 (S.I. 2010/659). They apply in relation to England only. Regulation 2 adds hantavirus disease, including hantavirus pulmonary or cardiopulmonary syndrome and haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome to the list of notifiable diseases in Schedule 1.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Wellesbourne Mountford Air Race) Regulations 2026
The North Lincolnshire Green Energy Park (Correction) Order 2026
summary: This Order corrects errors identified in the North Lincolnshire Green Energy Park Order 2025 (S.I. 2025/362), which granted development consent under the Planning Act 2008, following a request under paragraph 1(5)(a) of Schedule 4 to that Act.

title: The National Health Service (General Medical Services Contracts and Personal Medical Services Agreements) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2 and Schedule 1 to these Regulations amend the National Health Service (General Medical Services Contracts) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/1862) (“the GMS Contracts Regulations”). Regulation 3 and Schedule 2 to these Regulations amend the National Health Service (Personal Medical Services Agreements) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/1879) (“the PMS Agreements Regulations”).

title: The Television Selection Services (Designation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations designate a number of television selection services as regulated television selection services for the purposes of Part 3A of the Communications Act 2023 (c. 21) (prominence on television selection services).

title: The Online National Health Service Trust (Establishment) Order 2026
summary: This Order establishes a National Health Service trust called the Online National Health Service Trust (“the trust”).

title: The Regulated Electronic Programme Guide (Prescribed Description and Transitional Arrangements) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations set out a description of an electronic programme guide for the purposes of section 211A(2)(c) of the Communications Act 2003 (c. 21) (“the 2003 Act”).  Any electronic programme guide that falls within this description will be a “regulated electronic programme guide” for the purposes of section 211 of that Act (regulation of independent television services).

title: The School Organisation (Establishment and Discontinuance of Schools) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Schools Organisation (Establishment and Discontinuance of Schools) Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/3109) (“the Principal Regulations”). The Principal Regulations prescribe various matters relating to proposals for the establishment and discontinuance of schools pursuant to the provisions contained in Part 2 of the Education and Inspections Act 2006 (c. 40) (the “Act”).

The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Bristol) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Edinburgh) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
The Power to Award Degrees etc. (Richmond, The American International University in London, Inc.) Order 2026
summary: The Order authorises Richmond, The American International University in London, Inc. (UKPRN: 10005470) to grant taught awards for a fixed term beginning on 15th May 2026 and expiring at the end of the day on 15th May 2029.
